title: ZashterminalAgentTools
description: Function calling tool definitions available to the Zashterminal Secure Agent.

tools.name: fs.list_directory
tools.description: List files and directories in the specified path with file sizes and types.

max_entries.description: Maximum number of entries to return.

tools.name: fs.metadata
tools.description: Retrieve file metadata such as size, permissions, timestamps, and MIME type.

path.description: Path to the file or directory.

tools.name: fs.read_file
tools.description: Safely read text file contents within user-allowed scope with automated secret redaction.

path.description: Path to the file to read.

max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes to read from the file.

tools.name: fs.search_text
tools.description: Search for patterns or text inside files within a directory.

max_results.description: Maximum number of matching lines to return.

tools.name: fs.disk_usage
tools.description: Inspect disk usage for a specific path or mounted filesystem.

path.description: Path to evaluate disk usage for (defaults to user home).

tools.name: fs.write_staged_file
tools.description: Write a complete file content to a staging area for human review and backup before applying.

path.description: Final destination path where the file will be placed once approved.

content.description: Complete text content of the file.

tools.name: fs.propose_edit
tools.description: Propose an edit to an existing file, creating a staged diff for visual inspection.

new_content.description: Updated content for the target file.

tools.name: fs.create_directory
tools.description: Create a new directory (and any parent directories) in the user workspace.

tools.name: fs.move_to_trash
tools.description: Safely move a file or directory to the desktop Trash rather than deleting permanently.

path.description: Path of file or folder to move to trash.

tools.name: shell.run
tools.description: Run a read-only or low-risk command directly as an argument list (never via shell=True).

tools.name: shell.dry_run
tools.description: Simulate command execution using dry-run arguments without performing modifications.

argv.description: Command line arguments including dry-run flags.

tools.name: admin.run_action
tools.description: Execute a named, audited administrative action using Polkit authorization.

dry_run.description: Whether to perform a simulated dry-run if supported by the action.
